Overview

Paysandú is a city in PA with a population of 100,000. A port city on the Uruguay River, known for its beef processing industry and annual beer festival. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
